summary: Frontend-only testing of the new FANUC Vision-Guided Dual-Robot Trim & Drill Automation case study. Verified card placement (2nd, after Cobot), floating modal open/close (dark theme), sticky label, 6-item metadata grid, hero phrase '~40 min manual → ~6 min automated', all 6 section headings, exactly 13 unique images (all HTTP 200, naturalWidth>0, no duplicates, no missing), lightbox open/close, Escape and close button dismiss modal and restore body scroll, and Cobot + hero-centerpiece regressions. Also validated mobile (390x844) card + modal + close button. No functional issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Benign console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly' — likely from framer-motion whileInView inside the scrollable modal (parent scroller has default position: static). Not a defect but could be addressed by setting position:relative on the modal scroll container in ProjectModal.jsx.
IMG_0810 (teach pendant) and IMG_1096 (programming screen) intentionally have blurred proprietary regions — expected, not a defect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FANUC feature fully verified. All 13 images at /projects/fanuc/ return HTTP 200. Card order: [cobot, fanuc, gripper-fixture, faro-fairino-reliability, cad-3d-printing]. Section headings order verified: Manual Drilling → Conveyor-Based Robot Cell → Tooling/Control → Vision → Outcome → My Contribution. Lightbox uses data-testid fanuc-lightbox / fanuc-lightbox-close. Modal close via [data-testid=modal-close-btn] and Escape both work; body.style.overflow is restored to ''. Cobot flagship and hero-centerpiece click still open cobot-case-study. Only remaining console noise is a framer-motion static-container warning and benign WebGL performance notes.
